name: Health Station
description: The little village health station. Still open, for now. Bring a book; the wait is long.
greeting: Someone coughs in the waiting room.
The number machine is out of paper.

hello: Please take a number and wait.
doctor: Rest, fluids, and no Trokari this week.
buy: A tiny pinch. There, all done.
Brave! You can have a sticker.
enroll: Welcome to the course. Wash your hands first.
We need more nurses. Good choice.
lesson: Good. Now do it without fainting.
You're getting the hang of it.
work: Thank you. Long day, wasn't it?
broke: The fee is at the counter. Sorry, dear.
Not enough for the fee, I'm afraid.

then.message: The doctor finds nothing wrong with you and bills you anyway.

else.message: The doctor prescribes rest and fluids. You feel better.
